items.title: 5 Consumer Stocks Bucked August Gloom With Double-Digit Gains: ANF, FIGS, EL, ABNB, DASH
items.summary: August’s standout consumer stocks rallied despite weaker confidence, with strong earnings, turnarounds, and travel demand driving gains across the sector.

items.title: Estee Lauder vs Nike: One Turnaround Just Proved Itself, the Other Keeps Slipping
items.summary: Two battered consumer giants both hired new leadership to stop the bleeding, but the turnaround playbooks could not look more different right now. Before adding either to a retirement portfolio, the evidence separating genuine recovery from prolonged hope deserves a hard look.

items.title: Ulta Beauty Stock Falls After Upbeat Earnings
items.summary: Ulta Beauty’s  shares have been more like an eyesore this year and they were falling in the Friday premarket.  Ulta said it earned $6.55 a share in its fiscal second quarter, on revenue that rose nearly 9% year over year, to $3.04 billion.  Analysts were looking for earnings per share of $6.20 on revenue of $2.99 billion.

items.title: 1 High-Flying Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: Expensive stocks typically earn their valuations through superior growth rates that other companies simply can’t match. The flip side though is that these lofty expectations make them particularly susceptible to drawdowns when market sentiment shifts.
